"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/reverse-string/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

344. Reverse String

Write a function that reverses a string. The input string is given as an array of characters s.

You must do this by modifying the input array in-place with O(1) extra memory.

Example 1:

Input: s = ["h","e","l","l","o"]
Output: ["o","l","l","e","h"]

Example 2:

Input: s = ["H","a","n","n","a","h"]
Output: ["h","a","n","n","a","H"]

Constraints:

    1 <= s.length <= 10^5
    s[i] is a printable ascii character.
"""


class Solution:
    def reverseString(self, s: List[str]) -> None:
        """
        Do not return anything, modify s in-place instead.
        """
        left, right = 0, len(s) - 1
        while left < right:
            s[left], s[right] = s[right], s[left]
            left += 1
            right -= 1


sol = Solution()

arr1 = ["h", "e", "l", "l", "o"]
sol.reverseString(arr1)
print(arr1)  # ["o","l","l","e","h"]

assert arr1 == ["o", "l", "l", "e", "h"]

arr2 = ["H", "a", "n", "n", "a", "h"]
sol.reverseString(arr2)
assert arr2 == ["h", "a", "n", "n", "a", "H"]
